$comment: Single registry for every skill shipped by this repo (plan item P0-09).
'canonical' is the ONLY hand-edited source. Everything under .claude/skills/,
.cursor/skills/, .cursor/rules/ and AGENTS.md is generated from it by
installers/generate_agent_assets.py — never edit those by hand.
Layers describe what a skill needs, which decides the profiles that ship it:
core       = ships in all three profiles. MCP-aware guidance is rendered in
for webui/harness and stripped for skills, so the same
harness    = requires the MCP server; webui + harness profiles only.
standalone = no MCP, no backend; ships in all three profiles.

skills.summary: Plan an operator chain from a target + sample JSONL and emit a runnable pipeline. With MCP, also validates and commits it to the WebUI canvas.
DataFlow developer assistant: loads architecture knowledge and routes intents (new operator / pipeline / prompt, diagnose, review).
Scaffold production-grade operators (generate/filter/refine/eval) with registration, CLI wrapper and tests.
Build reusable prompt_template classes for existing operators with static acceptance checks.
Per-operator API reference (8 generate, 3 filter, 2 refine, 5 eval). Documentation only — read by generating-dataflow-pipeline, never invoked directly.

$comment_routing: Phrased as user intents, for the AGENTS.md routing table. An agent matches
the request against these and then reads only that skill's SKILL.md.

routing_triggers.generating-dataflow-pipeline: build a DataFlow pipeline from a target + sample JSONL, pick operators, or fix a pipeline that fails on field mismatches
routing_triggers.dataflow-dev: work inside the DataFlow repo itself: add an operator/pipeline/prompt, diagnose a DataFlow error, or review DataFlow code
routing_triggers.dataflow-operator-builder: scaffold a new operator with registry registration, a CLI wrapper and tests
routing_triggers.prompt-template-builder: write or rewrite a `prompt_template` class for an existing operator

$comment_cursor_rules: Cursor rules split into two sets. Rules that merely restate a skill are
GENERATED as thin pointers into .cursor/skills/<id>/SKILL.md, so the skill
text lives in exactly one place. Rules below are genuinely hand-written
repo guidance with no skill counterpart and are left untouched.
$comment_retired: Old rule filenames that no longer correspond to any skill id. Deleted on
regenerate. dataflow-dev.mdc / dataflow-operator-builder.mdc are NOT here:
those names are still produced by the generator from same-named skills.
$comment_frontmatter: SKILL.md frontmatter carries only `name` and `description` — the two keys
every agent implementation understands. Version and package kind live here
instead, so a non-standard key cannot confuse an agent that does not know it.
